title: Update profile
tagline: Inverse design: from an EI and Cross Section model and a target EI curve, propose the thickness profile that hits the target.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Knowing the EI you want is easy; knowing the core thickness that gives it is not. Update profile uses the modelled sections to solve, station by station, for the thickness that meets a target EI curve.
useWhen: Hit a target flex from an existing layup
Scale a design part-way toward a target
slides.caption: STD: section points above the neutral axis move up; output is a thickness curve.

points.head: STD
points.body: Full section model: move every point above the NA up by dt; bisection on dt until EI = target.

points.head: DELTA
points.body: Fit EI / width = alpha t^beta over all stations; solve t for the new EI.

points.head: PERCENT
points.body: Scale thickness by the EI ratio, using the fitted beta.

slides.title: The dialog (STD)
params: The EI and Cross Section feature.
The EI curve: an edge in the XZ plane, world Z in mm = EI in N m^2 (EI and Cross Section's <name>_EI, a measured or a target curve).
Inherit or Query (the Query edges are not used).
Apply only part of the change: measured + factor x (target - measured).
With ACP: read-only flex numbers of the target.

keys: Thickness wire, Z = thickness, true scale.
Per station: x, measured and updated thickness and EI; shown by the Profile Updates table (+ dt, dEI).
messages: A spline fit that fails draws red / magenta debug points; no error.

items.head: Growth above the NA
items.body: STD assumes added thickness goes on top (core / topsheet); a base-side change is not modelled.

items.head: Coarse target read
items.body: The target EI is sampled 11 times per edge; stations outside it are skipped.

items.head: Guard
items.body: A new thickness outside 0.1-200 mm is reset to the old one.

rows: EI and Cross Section, Estimate Stiffness, Estimate Deflection, Generate / Analyze baseline, Update profile
